title: Leaving the Hall: explicit formulas for Negut operators
summary: Recent major breakthroughs in $q,t$-combinatorics include the introduction of the Dyck path algebra $\mathbb{A}_{q,t}$ by Carlsson and Mellit and of the Catalanimals by Blasiak et al., both of which led, among other things, to independent proofs of different extensions of the rational shuffle conjecture of Bergeron et al. The first main contribution of this paper is a simple, explicit formula inside the algebra $\mathbb{A}_{q,t}$ for the Negut operators, yielding a direct, elementary connection between the original operators of the rational shuffle conjecture and the corresponding…
